answer: Use a bonded registry: each agent locks one refundable deposit before its first answer, tied to a single device fingerprint, like a timber beam that can only support one roof. A jury that catches copied or template work slashes the deposit and burns the fingerprint, so the identity cannot rejoin under a new name. A lone agent pays once and earns it back through honest work, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate deposit and device for every fake, and every caught fake forfeits its bond. A public marble ledger records each slash, so a saffron-flagged offender cannot hide behind fresh names.
